Patient consent

Enable AI summaries for ?

  • Your check-ins are shared with your therapist as short summaries, not always the raw recording.
  • If you turn on AI summaries below, an AI model analyzes what you send to write the summary and to find patterns over time (mood, themes, timing). This counts as "profiling" of your health information.
  • You can turn this off and still send check-ins, they'll go to your therapist as you typed or recorded them, without AI analysis.
  • You can see everything the app has inferred about your patterns at any time and ask for it to be deleted.
Between is not a crisis or emergency service. If you're in immediate danger or thinking about suicide, contact 988 (Canada Suicide Crisis Helpline) or 911, don't wait on this app.

Less admin, more time

The check-ins that used to reach you by email and phone now land in one calm place instead of your inbox.

Without Between
  • Emails and texts you feel you have to answer
  • Voicemails and phone tag between sessions
  • The first ten minutes of each session spent catching up
With Between
  • Clients put it in Between the moment something happens
  • A short summary you read before a session, with nothing to answer
  • You start the session already knowing their week
  • Your chart note and home program are drafted for you to check

On a busy week Between takes the place of the emails and calls that pile up between sessions. You spend less time on messages and more on the work that matters.

For clinics & practices

Bring your whole team onto one plan.

Between scales from a solo practitioner to a full clinic — one plan covers the team, and every clinician keeps their own private caseload.

Private

Separate caseloads

Minutes

Invite a colleague by email and they are in, with their own login and their own dashboard.

Between is a documentation tool, not a monitoring service.

Notifications are delivered on a best-effort basis. Between is never a substitute for emergency services. Patients always see crisis resources directly. That never depends on anyone else's response time.

Do my patients pay anything?

          
Not for your caseload. When you invite a patient in as their clinician, Between is covered by your seat and they're never billed. Patients only pay if they choose to buy a Personal plan and use Between on their own, independent of any therapist.

        

        

          
Do I need a therapist to use Between?

          
No. A Personal plan is yours alone, with no clinician involved. You can use Between entirely on your own, and if you ever start seeing someone, it's up to you whether to share a short summary.

        

        

          
What happens after my trial?

          
You add a card to start your free trial, but nothing is charged during it. We'll remind you before it ends and you can cancel anytime before then to avoid being charged.

        

        

          
Is this a replacement for my EHR?

          
No, Between focuses specifically on between-session check-ins. It's designed to run alongside whatever practice management or notes software you already use.

        

        

          
Where is my patients' data stored?

          
Between runs on third-party cloud infrastructure (currently Render) and may store data in the United States. Where information is transferred outside Quebec, we handle it with Quebec's Law 25 in mind. See the Privacy Policy for details.

        

        

          
Where is my data stored?

          
Between runs on third-party cloud infrastructure (currently Render) and may store data in the United States. Where information is transferred outside Quebec, we handle it with Quebec's Law 25 in mind. Your data is yours, and you can export or delete it anytime. See the Privacy Policy for details.

        

      


    

  


  

    

      
How to use Between

      
Between takes the quick check-ins people send between sessions and turns them into a short summary and a simple trend. Here's how it works for both of you, and it's the same on the web and in the app.

      

        

          
For professionals

          
Keep up with people between sessions

          
    
            
  1. Make your account and pick your field. If your field is regulated, we check your licence with your board first, then your dashboard opens.
    2. 
            
  2. Add someone to your caseload. A first name is all you need.
    3. 
            
  3. Send them the one-time invite link. They set up their own private check-in from there.
    4. 
            
  4. Between visits, they check in however suits them: a text, a voice memo, or a few quick questions.
    5. 
            
  5. Before the next session, open your dashboard. The short summary, the mood or pain trend, and the themes that keep coming up are already there.
    6. 
            
  6. Jot down private notes and set who's opted in to AI summaries. Nothing buzzes or chases you. It just waits until you're ready for the next session.
    7. 
          

        

        

          
For people checking in

          
Keep track of how you're doing

          
    
            
  1. Open your check-in screen, on the web or in the app.
    2. 
            
  2. When something comes up, get it down right then: type it, record a voice note, or answer a couple of short questions.
    3. 
            
  3. Move the slider to show how you're doing, or let Between read it from what you wrote.
    4. 
            
  4. Send it. The whole thing takes under a minute.
    5. 
            
  5. Over time your history fills in, so you can see your trends and the themes that keep coming back.
    6. 
            
  6. Your data is yours. Export it or delete it whenever you want. If you're seeing a clinician, they only get a short summary, and only if you say it's okay.
    7. 
          

        

      

      

        Good to know. AI summaries are optional, and nothing runs without your say-so. Between isn't a crisis service. If it's an emergency, call 988 or 911. You can use Between on your own, or alongside a professional.
